description: Use this when someone asks to permanently delete a blog post in every language. Given the original post's id, that post and all its translations are deleted and their pages go offline; given a translation's own id, nothing is deleted although the result still says deleted. Returns the id. Not for unpublishing.

id.description: Id of the original post (its originalArticleId); every language version of it is deleted

name: delete_article

articleId.description: The id passed in. The API deletes every article whose originalArticleId equals it, so a translation id deletes nothing even though status is deleted.

title: Delete a blog post
